title: BODIES COVER THE PROMPTS
why: His note of 2026-10-14: can the press E text be blocked by player or enemy sprites. The prompts over a crate, a door, a body, the seal or a ring are drawn over the world, so a body could never stand over them. Each prompt now knows how deep in the scene its object stands and takes out of itself the shape of every body standing in front of that object: the player, a teammate, a pillager or a machine. The body shows through, so it reads as standing over the text, at its own size. A body behind the object, and a prompt that nothing stands in front of, draw as they did.
now: Bodies standing in front of an object now cover its press E prompt.
